u: [U alphabet, u Vowel, forty-one alphabets, it is five vowels in eight vowels. - Tipi,4 (A), 627].  (1) U dhātu. (2) U Paccaya. (3) U Vibhati. (4) U āguṃ (Comes from U). (5) U which comes from another alphabet.  Tipi,4 (A), 627 U(bya)].  [ It is a Puda in 20 Upasārapuda. U sadda (meaning Siva) is Nāmapuda, dukkhalābha, In Nisedha rogamutta meaning, it is nipātapuda. The rest puda is Upasārapuda, In Kathana meaning, has two kinds Dhāta and upasāra. In 75, (uda-saṃ)]. (1) Ascending. (2) Above. Making it in the upper place., The upper case. (3) Prescribing. (4) Free from. (5) Being (or) Happen. (6) Gets (the benefit) nature. (7) It has the ability. (8) It chants by form. (9) Raising up. (10) Reproach. (11) Exceed, Exceedingly. See - Ujjaṅgala. (12) give up. See -  Uklāpa. (13) Taking (or) Carrying. (14) Prohibits. See - Ukkama, uppatha, urabbha. (15) It hasn"t special meaning, just only add words, Only full words. See - Ubbhinditva. (16) Satisfy. (17) Fulfillment. (18) Flawless. (19) As it has high strength. (20) Show obvious. (21) As it is clever. (22) Nibbāna. (23) Has to suffer. (24) Seeing above. (25) Crossing (or) Cutting. See - Ukkhepakavāta.
